description: Project-scoped persistent memory store for coding agents
notes: EngramDB loads ONNX Runtime at run time rather than embedding it, so the runtime is installed as a separate, updatable Scoop package.
Run 'engramdb doctor' to confirm which runtime was resolved.
Run 'engramdb setup' to register the MCP server and hooks with Claude Code.
post_install: # The release archive also carries a copy of onnxruntime.dll so that a
# direct download works without a package manager. Under Scoop the
# 'onnxruntime' dependency owns the runtime, so drop the bundled copy and
# leave exactly one on the system — otherwise the archive's pinned build
# would silently win over the one Scoop updates, since engramdb searches
